text: Ordered a couple of dishes - Japchae and the Bibim bap. It was delicious and we would definitely go back. The banchan (side dishes) that came with the entrees were also yummy! We are super excited to have an authentic Korean restaurant so near our home! The tables in front are dog friendly!

Everything on the menu is delicious!! There are no wrong choices. 
We came across this little gem serendipitously as we were hungrily awaiting our tour at the Country Music Hall of Fame. We had such good experience that we decided to come back on a date night our last night in Nashville. 
The special cucumber margarita was amazing! And I highly recommend making it spicy for an additional $1. 
You can't go wrong with the chips/salsa and guac trip. It was very generous portions and the chips were hot from the oven which was a pleasant surprise. 
My favorites were the shrimp and short rib tacos. They're all tasty and the presentation is beauuutiful! The atmosphere is chill and lovely and COVID precautions were taken.

Overall I'd say this is a pretty decent pizza place in Tampa and Living walking distance helps too! Not always in the mood for their pies or calzones (white special ricotta with pepperoni is my favorite!) so we opted for salads and sandwiches. Surprisingly for a pizza place their subs and cheesesteaks are really good!

Had the catfish platter, boyfriend had the mixed fried platter. Meal was good, however it didn't have much of a Louisiana taste. I expected Creole and Cajun flavors but the meal was good. Service was good. Food came out rather quickly.

Lovely bar with great food. They are part of the club savor program with i love. Oysters Rockefeller was AMAZING. Same with the raw. Bartender Megan is awesome. Would recommend this place to any seafood lovers around!

These taste like taco kit tacos. The drinks were decent but the tacos are horrible. I was looking forward to enjoying these tacos because they look good. Too bad they don't taste as good as they look.

Another excellent meal at Effie's. We had a large party. The staff was pleasant & accommodating to everyone. We loved the calamari, appetizer plater. Everyone also enjoyed our meals. In the world of eating salmon, this one is extra delicious! Most tasty moussaka. 2 different lamb dishes, shrimp & rice, pasta. The cheese blintz to finish hit the spot. Byob that always satisfies the belly!!
Delicious food! Everything was so fresh and flavorful. the service was great. It's such a cozy place, I would definitely recommend!

King Wok is my go-to place for pho. Great for hangovers and cold winter days! They also do take-out and they separate the broth and noodles so you can just heat up the broth when you get home. Also, their spring rolls are bomb.

Did not realize how west this was; it's in Traders Point area. The store is really nice and so is the staff. I appreciate how kind and attentive they were to us while in the store. There are so many options of chocolate for anyone who likes chocolate. Found out that they can do custom requests like a cake shop. They have so many custom molds it's astonishing. There is easy parking(weird back set up though) the store offers military discount and has molds for army and marines!!! Had a blast and can't wait to go back for more chocolate!

This place is a godsend , it is definitely the most authentic flavorful Mexican restaurant in Tucson! Once you step into this little nook, it brings you to a different place, the waitress there is always super nice and welcoming. And whoever the chef is, is absolutely skilled and cooks every dish with care. My personal favorite thing to order from here is the posole and some beef and corn tamales! The posole is always spot on when I go, and the tamales as well. The tamales are filled with just the right amount of beef and the masa is so flavorful and just mouthwatering. My boyfriend has tried quite a few different dishes, and not surprisingly they were all scrumptious!!!! The milanesa he got was superb, the beef was cooked and seasoned perfectly and was fried to perfection. Aside from how amazing the food and service is, the prices and portions are so reasonable and I want to say underpriced for how good it is! The portions are enough to fill any foodie. And delicious enough to satisfy anyone looking for a real meal. I will always have Perfecto's be my go to place for posole!!!! You have to go!

Mixed review. Really wanted to leave a 2.5 star, but I'll be nice and give em a 3. Last night was my first time there. We took a big group, but not a "huge" group. We went after church let out. It was only a group of 10 young adults (we are all over 18 years of age). We were quiet, we were not disruptive in any way. The food was good, especially considering it was my first time there. 

The downside is how ride the guy was to us. At 9:92pm he came and said word for word in a very heavily sarcastic, full of attitude tone: "we close at 9, so you might want to hurry up and get you and your friends out of here." 

Okay...I get it. We are sorry, we didn't realize you closed at 9. We didn't realize we had stayed over by two measly minutes. But one of our group members was not finished eating his nachos. They could've at least let us stay until he finished those. Or, if we absolutely had to leave that very instant - dude could've been nicer about it. 

We aren't gonna let this keep us from going back, but just a heads up to Blue Coast, you may wanna teach your employees some manners. 

Great food, much better than Chipotle. I tried there one time and was not a fan of the food at all so I was hesitant to try blue coast. Had the staff been nicer, this would've been an all around great experience. Again, the food was fantastic. That guy with the bad attitude is my only issue out of this whole thing. The girl that was on staff last night, she was super nice. The guy was the rude one.

We can't pass by Brophy Bros for our anniversary dinner. This was our 40th and as good as ever! Always hands down,  the best fish and chips year after year without fail. The fish is fresh and always fried to perfection. Great batter, light and crispy. We had the battered shrimp too and also perfect! Great service. We always feel welcome and cared for. Love you Brophy Bros. See you next year! Btw we have the same experience at the Ventura location. Always the best!

Middle aged Blonde lady maybe Amber. Was very disrespectful. As we left the restaurant after being refused service she said "We don't want you here" called to speak to a manager Erik and he sided with his employee. Needless to say we will not be supporting this business and there horrendous attitude towards us.
Like most places in Sun Valley walking in is scary to leave your car and everyone is tweaking out.

Best Mexican food in our area. Very authentic. Reasonably priced. Friendly wait staff. We love the complimentary chips with cheese & beans drizzle. Our a favorites are the tostadas, fajitas, shrimp skewers, burritos and tacos!!! Desserts are delicious. Family friendly.

Since moving to Langhorne from Bristol, this has been my go-to for good Chinese food.  Best chicken and broccoli around.  Only complaint is that sometimes the food isn't the same.  An example would be that my life mein seems to taste different every time.
Solid!! Dumplings are awesome beef soup was perfect and these guys deserve all the success in the world!!

One of the kind Resturant 
Great service ,great ambiance and phenomenal food!
Anything you order for the menu is one of the kind!
Walk off the beaten path was definitely worth it.  Amazing BBQ with fantastic sides.  I had a Pulled Pork sandwich with BBQ beans and cole slaw.  Superb.  Prices are very reasonable.

We were craving tacos because #tacotuesday and missed our 'Urban Eats' which was the previous tenant. My coworker was thrilled to see that they had a ground beef option, we both settled for taco salads, hers was ground beef of course, and mine was shredded chicken. The servers and manager were super attentive, the queso and churros were great too! While they are still very new, this looks like it will be a fun place for Cinco De Mayo, bright and festive decorations, and a fun wheel to spin behind the bar too. Welcome to downtown, #Tequila! Please stay and make yourself at home!!

I think this is turning into my favorite bar in the downtown Nashville area. We stayed at Niito nearby and came here multiple times. I've since moved to Tennessee and have been back here again! Great service, huge bar, massive outdoor area and happy vibes all around!

Service was great and place was clean. Sushi was not bad but definitely wasn't good. I think because the sushi was so average, I can understand why so many people don't like sushi if they are only finding this bland average sushi.

I really wanted to like Pop, but I thought it was just okay. We came in for dinner, but their choices were what I felt overpriced and underwhelming. We ended up getting the hummus and a couple cocktails which was good. I really liked the hummus and the amount of veggies and sides that you get with it. The cocktails are made with champagne and honestly, that's all I could taste. I think this would be such a fun place to go with a small group of girlfriends, but it wasn't what I expected or what we really wanted that night.
The best food hands down! The staff were friendly and attentive, the ambiance was amazing. Just a great overall experience. Did I already say the food was amazing...even the dessert.

No entertainment do to COVID. I needed a night out. Took in a show at punchline where they had social distal and took health precautions. The stage was outside. The seating was comfortable and better than the indoor seating. The ticket came with food selections for each ticket holder. The food menu is very limited. There was still a 2 drink minimum. It was a chilly night. The set up was really nice. The comedians were excellent. Enjoyable show and I will make sure to catch another outdoor venue show. They have 2 shows running at the same time across the street from each other.

This place has phenomenal food and options that can please everyone on the menu. If you're with more than 2 people I recommend sharing some appetizers. They were so different and delicious! The only reason I'm not leaving a five star review is because of our server. After a mix up with one of my friends she placed an order of the chicken tacos instead of the fish  tacos and a little later made a comment under her breath that only I heard. It might have been an off night but it definitely affected our experience. Once we asked for our bill they arrived all mixed up and had to be printed and fixed three times. We had planned to come back with some other friends but decided to try some other spots around the area.

We came here for the first time today and was greeted right away . The staff here is very friendly and knowledgeable.  We ordered the Cuban sandwich with fries and 2 empanadas  , one chicken and one beef.  The empanadas arrived to our table first , the crust was thin and crisp with a very generous amount of filling.  It was hard to say which one was better,  they were excellent! We noticed while we were waiting for our sandwiches to come out that more customers were coming in and they were Hispanic  , now I know that this place is the real deal ! Out food arrives and yes indeed they were amazing  ! The bread was lightly crispy on the outside and so so soft inside  . I tasted every layer , the ham ,the pork and cheese .... the BEST that I've ever had.  The fries were thin and crispy with great flavor.  The part that's not good is that this Restaurant is in Oldsmar and I live in Clearwater  . I will make the drive  to come there for sure , it was awesome  . It's a smaller place ,but is setup very nicely inside to seat groups together  comfortably.  The food does take time to come to your table , everything is cooked fresh , it's not terribly long but it's not McDonald's either !

Fantastic addition to The Yard and Fishers! The Test Kitchen is a unique concept that I absolutely love! 

The concept: The Test Kitchen is a "culinary launch pad" that houses three different entrepreneurs/restaurants. It serves as a place for each chef/entrepreneur to test their menu and restaurant's concept. Each restaurant will be in the Test Kitchen for a year or two with the end goal of being able to launch into a full scale restaurant!

The Test Kitchen is a food court/hall style layout. You order and pay at the restaurant(s) of your choice and then find a table. At the table, a server will come by and take your drink order. They offer Sun King beers, cocktails and wine. 

I tried food from 2 of the 3 restaurants and all of the food was fantastic! I can't wait to go back and try more of the food. My only compliant is that they have plastic silverware. The plastic silverware was so flimsy and hard to eat with, as well as, a little wasteful. 

In addition to the above, the Test Kitchen has "The Signature Table." It is a small kitchen surrounded by a large table that will have different culinary events, such as classes, demonstrations and dinners. 

The Fishers Test Kitchen just opened over the weekend, so be sure to check it out!

Came here for to pick up a doordash delivery for a customer. I was told 15 min for the order. I decided to wait the time for it. After about 25 min I asked for an ETA, the lady up front said its coming out now. Ten min later I ask for a manager and she came out to tell me "we are very busy and it's going to be at least another 30 minutes, please do your other deliveries first." Over an hour to make sandwiches!!??? Come on.

Whoa! I stopped in for brunch today and the only option was an indoor table. Sat down and was greeted quickly and was offered water and info about oysters and a punch. Ordered a eggs Benedict with hash, standard brunch fair that was just that, standard. Cocktails are cool and crafty, the strawberry swing was basic but really nice. What took our experience from average to superb was our server Joe! Service was quick, polite and super fun! He talked up the dinner menu and we decided to make a reservation to come back next week to visit him again! Can't wait to come back snd see what else this place had to offer.

Wow, Max's Steaks was definitely incredible. Love this place. The food was great, Mushroom Cheesesteak was tasty. Really courteous, attentive and experienced. Glad to see a place like that in this area.

The only thing this place for is getting stabbed or getting food poisoning. Whether you're a tourist or a local, avoid this spot at all costs. There are way too many better restaurants in the area to waste your time here

Cinco de Mayo. Ordered online. At 4:30. Got a confirmation email at 4:36. Got the email after that stating it would be ready at 6:31. 

Got in a line at 5:10 that wrapped through their parking lot and out onto the road and waited for an hour and forty minutes. Made it to the doors at 6:40. 

PISSED. They got too overwhelmed so they cancelled orders. Including mine. After an hour and a forty minutes in line. They should have stopped taking new orders until they got caught up. Told me I should get an email confirming my cancellation sometime in the next hour. 

I PLACED MY ORDER AT 4:30. 

Never going there again.

I had the veggie breakfast bowl and something about it that I can't seem to pinpoint wasn't really that good. The consistency of the kale on the bottom of the bowl and the softer texture things (egg, avocado, etc) didn't seem to mesh well. The sauce that came on top was good but there was not enough of it to save the meal. They do offer an Orange Theory discount if you workout next door so that was nice.

We had a late lunch one Sunday and felt like family - laughed with server, asked for special changes to menu items and were accommodated in every way. Food was fantastic. Being from out of town we would never have found it but we will visit every time we are back in Reno.
Amazing food, fast delivery. Went and picked up my order and shop was following all COVID protocols. I highly recommend this place. This is my favorite Indian restaurant and I've tried them all.

We arrived at 7:45 had a reservation at 8:15 and they told us that they were running behind. They suggested we could go to the bar area and order an appetizer and that they would come get us. We decided to sit at a table by the bar and nobody came to take our drink order or appetizer order after plenty of eye contact with waitresses. After 30 min. I finally went up to the bar ordered drinks and appetizer. At 9 pm the waitress  escorted us to a table. Since  I have a gluten allergy they had to make my food in the kitchen which was fine with me. However my meat was overcooked and the chicken was dry. I was very disappointed to pay such a high price. Once we got seated things went much smoother. My husband liked his prawns and steak. We regretted being seated next to a large group of what appeared to be college students.  They were dropping F__ bombs like they were being paid to do it. They just looked over at us and looked at us like we were road kill. We should have gone to Longhorn Steakhouse.

The best bbq I've ever had the brisket is amazing you can't go wrong with their menu...the Smokey sweet is the best unless you like it hot!! If so they have just about anything you could imagine to drink at the bar you name they can make it, I really would try it if you haven't you won't regret it... the manager Cory has always been available and helpful with any requests... one of the top places to get lunch or dinner in Mooresville hands down...

First of all, the customer service is amazing here. I have severe food allergies & they were COMPLETELY accommodating & wonderful to me, shoutout to Wilson! Thanks for being a great waiter! 

The food I personally had was alright, the salmon was great but the potatoes & veggies were unseasoned & bland. All of my family's dishes looked awesome. 

All employees were wearing masks PROPERLY & I even saw them turn someone away for not wearing one. Lots of outside seating to avoid exposure. Overall a good spot!

Found an excellent restaurant near home that serves some great Japanese, Thai, Vietnamese food! They had so many great choices on the menu that it was very hard to choose! I eventually chose the vegetable tempura to start and then some vegetable yakisoba with added tofu and a strawberry mango boba tea! Lillard was an excellent server who helped me with the menu and attended my every need! I will certainly be back!

Stopped in while doing some shopping and wanted something different.  My husband and I both had Mediterranean Salads. He added tilapia and I added  salmon. The salads were great and the service and extra assistance from the manager who recognized that we were first timers were outstanding. The salads and sweetened pecans, feta, garbanzo beans, fire-roasted red peppers and red onions (the latter could be cut back as we both regretted later.) 
If you could turn the heat up a little more, it might be a little more enjoyable for eating as I had to keep my coat on.

My husband and i came here one Saturday night because I wanted seafood and they had sea bass in the menu. Much to my delight, they had a special of Red Snapper and 2 scallops that night. This was the perfect set up for my seafood needs. Everything was perfectly cooked. My husband had the lobster Mac n cheese. The whole experience was great. They did a great job with social distancing and really made us feel comfortable. Our waitress was amazing. I highly recommend Salt for a great meal!!

I am impressed, Thai Lanna & Sushi was simply great. Thai Lanna & Sushi has an overall great vibe and a fun crowd that hangs there. Easily the most flavourful dish was Coconut Cake, me and my friend genuinely loved it. It was so delightful. The servers are really friendly and accommodating. Certainly will come to Thai Lanna & Sushi again.

Lovely people run this place - the sort who remember your name and remember how you like your coffee.  It's always clean, and before the pandemic was a place folks gathered to have a chat before moving on with their day.  It's very cozy, so currently customers must be mindful of COVID-19 and no lingering.  The owners are masked, but still as welcoming.  A locally owned business.
Amanda was amazingly helpful and super nice. Jay was diligently making sure the bar was clean. Tre was an awesome bartender as well! I will be back soon!

I love Lennys.    I've been eating there for 30+ years and it never disappoints. They have this sandwich on the menu, an open face pastrami sandwich on a knish. One of the best things I've ever eaten in my life.  The service is always wonderful, these ladies rock!

Okay steak and drinks..  things and flavor profile on the plate didn't come together for a $100 steak.  Clearly the place to be in Boise on a Friday evening after a long flight.  Showed up around peak dinner time without a reservation and was able to get a table quickly.  Guess that's the nice part.
I had a great lunch there. I like the Burritos a lot. Every time my boss is in town we have to eat there

Like it but really wish they upped their portion sizes. The beef sandwiches need way more meat and I'm always left with way more bread than meat.  The pasta is good but portion sizes are again TINY.   Hot dogs are good though. Every time I get the soup the noodles are mushy as the broth tastes like water-- zero flavor. 
Not the cheapest but if you crave a Chicago dog this place is good.

This is my favorite restaurant EVER! The place is cool and very clean. Even though you have to wait most of the time it is so worth it. The people that work there are best helpful and serve you well. The food is delicious and not too expensive.The location isn't the best part of town, but the store makes it very enjoyable! I would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone.

They were ok.  I should have done the carne asada instead of the brisket.  The brisket was bland--more like pot roast.  Also, the grilled cheese added to my wife's taco was odd--a plastic sheet of cheese should not be on a taco.  Overall, they were average for the price you pay.

This message is not to complain the business it's a suggestion from being a royal customer for over 15 years. 

We ordered four take out meals, when we got home all the burgers and fries were soggy and wet from wrapping inside the bag, is there a better way to enjoy a quality food even it's from a take out order?  I know In and Out burger they offers option to pack your take out orders in a tray instead of paper bag. This way your food is not stacking and steaming inside the bag.
Probably the bet pizza in Nashville. Which might not be saying much but still it's really good.

Another business in Safety Harbor full of people crowding outside and no mask rules enforced. I want to eat, not go somewhere to catch a virus. 

Sorry, but the food is not much better. Tried it a few times before the virus hit to give them the benefit, sadly it was just not as good as food I can get 10 minutes away. That and they ran out of sides...was much better at the old location.

This restaurant has proven to be everything I needed and more on bourbon street!! If you come here definitely get the red fish, truly incredible! Come and request your server to be Asheigh she will blow your mind with fast service with the best support, love, and compassion you never knew you needed. Looking for exquisite seafood at a convenient location with servers that will boost your self esteem?? Then come on over to Red Fish Grill.

We came in last night for our girls night. Perfect from beginning to end! Lobster mussels on the Monday Mussel menu were the most delicious mussels I have ever tasted! I had the special steak frites paired with a perfect stuffed lobster tail. Service was on point. The restaurant has went above and beyond to ensure social distancing and  cleanliness to make every guest feel safe. Be sure to try one or more of the homemade desserts. Each one was delicious and perfectly sized to share!! Overall the best food in South Jersey with great ambiance and location. Can't wait to go back!!

All I have to say is- get the chicken plate! The rice is so buttery and fluffy and the chicken and veggies are cooked to perfection! I love the woman who is in there all the time- she is always so sweet and appreciative of my business! I tried this place 3 years ago and my life hasn't been the same since!

Came because of referrals and the fact the place has been 60 years...50 w current owner. Pizza was good; we r from NY ... so not quite what we were looking for but for Florida pizza? It was great. The only reason I gave it only 3 stars is because it was beyond dirty... not just old, but dirty! Anyone ever hear of windex and a mop here??

Came here for my birthday dinner, food and service was fabulous! We ordered the lobster ceviche which was great... the caprese salad... the three different calamari's which was so delicious... and my friends got the filet which they raved about... for dessert definitely get the Tres Leches... it is amazing! I'll be back here for sure!

What an experience, from start to finish by the amazing folks at Marina Cantina in Clearwater Beach!

We were celebrating a last-attempt Anniversary/Honeymoon, and with all of the COVID-19 problems of rescheduling, closing, distancing, etc. The amazing staff at Marina Cantina took our expectations and really outdid them! 

It start with Ryan, the Manager, taking our reservation and getting us an amazing table overlooking the harbor, and letting us know they would "do amazing" to take care of us! And WOW did he ever with the view! Unbelievable table, an awesome personalized greeting at the host table, and we were on our way!

A big thank you to VALERIE and KELLEY for tag teaming out table. These ladies did an amazing job in offering options, opinions and honest reviews of their food and drinks! Their service was top notch and amazing! 

The food, the drinks all were a homerun! We really recommend the Seafood Enchiladas, these bad boys were AWWWESOME! The awesome Tequila/Coconut drink also was incredibly delicious! Even the Chroizo Queso was out of this world!

We have found our GO TO restaurant forever in Clearwater Beach - what an amazing place!

Food, service, ambiance on outside deck all fantastic. A friend recommend lucky lobster for lunch and my family was not disappointed. We had the New England lobster club, lobster mac and cheese, and lobster cobb salad. All were fresh, flavorful and cooked to perfection. Well done!
The breakfast was amazing. This is the cinnamon and banana pancake with bacon. We were able to eat inside and the service was very good.
The service was extremely slow. My steak was very chewy and my vegetables were very spicy. My husbands sushi was very good but we sat for over 30 minutes waiting for our bill.

Very unfriendly restaurant. They will not move patio tables to accommodate more than 4 people so they discourage customers by quoting an unrealistic wait time when obviously there is immediate seating available. It's been over 2 years since I last visited thinking they may have gotten better but I was wrong!!!

I can't believe we've lived here a whole year and we just now learned about Westside Cafe. It's one of those hole-in-the-wall gems - a local's best-kept secret. We wanted a late breakfast and after striking out at several high-profile restaurants (there were long lines and an hour wait) - we thought we'd try Westside Cafe - next to Safeway on MaeAnne Drive. Extensive menu with lots of options for breakfast and lunch. Imaginative and fun menu items - Divorce Benedict anyone? We absolutely loved the food - husband loved his breakfast burrito and my waffle was fluffy and delicious. Served with a side of homemade strawberry sauce. Can't wait to go back and try their lunch items!
It was my first time there it was cute and absolutely delicious! The guy at the counter was so nice and helpful I will be back :)

This place is a hidden gem in Philadelphia. I am surprised that more people are not talking about it. The real reason why we came is because of the review by barstool. I popped in at 4:30 on a Saturday in December. Here is my review:

Service: 
- excellent service. Answered all of my questions before placing an order
- I came before the start of dinner, however it was still a 45 minute wait. I did not mind as that gave me time to explore the area. 
- no phone number to call. Just walk up to the window and place your order. Found this slightly inconvenient as I wanted to call to make sure they were open before making the trip. 
- very nice individual. All of them complied with COVID protocols. 
- when I went to pick up my order, they saw me waiting in line and asked me to come to the front to pick it up. I did not think they would remember me, but they did and saved me 10-15 minutes of waiting.

Food: 
The pizza is a solid 9.3. My crust was a little burnt but I know some people prefer that. Very thin and very good ingredients used to make it.
- fair price for a pizza pie. I think it was $24 for a pie
- wish they had more varieties or toppings, but oh well.

Ambience:
- N/A

I searched multiple sites to find what people say is the best Cuban sandwich in Tampa.  They all said to go here!  Well the reviews were spot on!   The location was easy to find. Great attentive staff.  Nice restaurant with plenty of seating inside and out. It even had a separate coffee bar area with coffee house style seating in that area. 

The cuban.  Oh the cuban! It was so good! It was a super moist sandwich with all the classic tastes of a good cuban sandwich. But the real star was the bread. This may be the best cuban bread I have ever had!  Amazing!  

A must try in Tampa. The bread itself is worth coming for!

Walked in around 430pm. Only two men In the place. The bartender welcomed us and told us to sit anywhere. Waitress came right over took our drink orders (water). Then told us she would give us some time to look over menu.  Waited and waited only to find her on her cell phone and not paying any attention to the fact we were trying to get her attention. Finally just walked across the parking lot to the burger joint.  Will not be back
Food was overprice, small portions and not very good flavors! Some friends invited me because they said the food and  ambiance was good. Not in my opinion!

went in today. and won't ever be back. our waitress made snarky comments to us, to other customers and especially her coworkers. it took about 8 minutes just to get drinks. then it took another 30-40 minutes to get our food. it wasn't busy at all. maybe 7 tables had people? one family came in, sat for 10 min with nobody coming to help them so they left. the food was also questionable. our fries seemed to have sat for quite some time, the cheese for the fries as old and my friends chicken strips were super chewy and seemed to not be fully cooked. definitely won't be back.

Worst customer service ever!
Used to order done here from time to time busy the place has gone way downhill. 
Tried to order from here about a month ago. After an hour the App said they were still prepping my food. I called thinking something was wrong with the app but no, it was accurate. After an hour my food was even in the oven yet!! They said it would be another hour. Person on the phone was very rude. I asked to speak to the manager who was just as rude and no help. I cancelled the order. 
To my mistake I Just tried again tonight. The online app wasn't working so we called the store. Tried to order the $5.99 deal and they told us that was an online deal only. But we couldn't order online and they wouldn't honor it. Once again the staff was rude. Hung up and ordered elsewhere. Crappy service, poorly managed. Done with that place. I imagine it's only a matter of time before it's closed.

My Thai is a cherished neighborhood  restaurant for us. We have been enjoying the pretty room, delightful welcome and superb food for decades. About time I left a review here! In this quarantine period, our friends at My Thai  and the consistently delicious meals they produce have been a huge comfort. That pumpkin soup.... :-)

We went to Mesh to celebrate NYE by supporting a local business! I made a reservation ahead of time and found it very impressive that they called me 2 days before to confirm the reservation and asked if we were able to climb stairs if needed.

We started off with two appetizers the bread option and the cheese & meat tray. The bread option came with several awesome breads, and oil & balsamic mix plus a garlic butter. For dinner I got the swordfish and a cup of lobster bisque. The entire meal was fabulous but the bread appetizer was by far my favorite.

Mesh also has a full bar and such a variety of high quality wines. Our entire experience was great. I felt safe with the covid protocol and they offered masks and hand sanitizer upon arrival.

I definitely look forward to celebrating important events here in the future!

Cute little Cafe . But not worth the wait for 1 hour to cook a omelette with home fries & bacon egg wrap 
They need a bigger cooking grill for the Chef. 
Can not keep up with the orders And the orders keep getting messed up for customers

We absolutely loved this restaurant.  Everything from the food & drink menu options to the overall design and exceptional service.  Not really sure why we didn't try it sooner.  This place books up fast so make sure you get reservations in well in advance.  It's worth the wait!

Not super excited with my first time experience! Ordered the Oriental chicken with jasmine rice...and onion rings.  Food came in a great timely manner. However the temperature of the food was unsatisfactory.  
Once we told the staff, she offered to bring more rice. SERIOUSLY the rice and the sauce and chicken. Are to infuse together to make a great taste why wait for plane ole rice and not the whole plate..  The battered onion rings were nice and hot, however they need to change the fry bat,because the onion rings were dark, and looked burnt.  However management was nice enough to take four dollars off the order. Yippie!! NOT!!   
Also let me add, expect to pay at least 10.00 per meal.  Nothing less, or small portion options...
I am not in a rush to go back..

#curbside during the #pandemic 

It was a rough day at work and it was getting ready to storm. Being an essential worker and going home to a K-9 who is fearful of storms, I needed a treat for "me". As I cruised down Hampton, the thought of wings and rings popped into my head. So, I made a quick turn into the parking lot for one of the best little dive bars in my hood. 

I knew what I wanted, so I quickly pulled out my cell phone and called the number posted on their curbside promotional sign. A young lady cheerfully answered the phone. When ordering the wings, she asked if I wanted bone-in or boneless. For some reason, I always go bone-in. Boneless is just another name for nuggets. When I ordered my onion rings, she promptly asked if i wanted a full basket or a side order. What? She explained the difference in size and since it was just me, I took advantage of the side order. That was great customer service, because I would have wasted food not eating a complete basket. 

These wings and rings both hit the spot. My wings were, Butter Garlic Parmesan. The order was 6 pieces, perfectly divided into 3 flats and 3 drums. I'm always impressed when a bar makes sure they are equal portions of the two. My  wings were crisp, juicy, meaty and full of garlic flavor. 

For a dive bar, their rings are top-notch. No frozen rings from a bag here. They're Panko encrusted, seasoned and served with a remi sauce. Breading in house, makes a difference. For me, the rings had enough flavor, that I

I'm from the bay and I LOVE this little mom and pop's restaurant. 

Delicious food

Speedy service 

Excellent customer service 

People trippin. TRY IT !

Wow! What a hidden gem ! I've driven past this lil place in the tuck , sooooo many times and never noticed it until I went on maps in my phone and searched breakfast & brunch so glad I did.  Called in my order and the guy was so nice . Enormous Sandwiches for the money , it was excellent keep up the great job. I'm a very picky person so this a great find for me will definitely tell friends and return again soon

Sooo... it was a cool spot on the water. My sister and I sat outside even though it was chilly, and listened to the live music from the bar across the river. It checks the box on "atmosphere". Our waitress was really sweet.

Here's where it gets sticky. First our drink order came out wrong. No big deal, it gets fixed. We order the lobster bisque and are served tomato soup. That gets fixed too, but I'm thinking we should have stayed with the tomato cause the lobster bisque was pretty gross. Gloopy consistency, fishy flavor and presentation was careless with soup running down the sides of the cups. My sister ate about half of hers, I threw in the towel after one bite. Nobody asked why it was basically untouched.

For mains, I got the snow crab legs with a loaded baked potato and seasonal vegetables. The baked potato was fine, about what you'd expect from anywhere. Vegetables were a limp overcooked mush that seemed like it had sat in a warming tray all day long. BUT the crab legs were super good, meaty and seasoned well. They are the source of a star in this review.

My sister got the seafood "bucket". It came with a few crab legs, mussels, clams, corn on the cob, boiled potatoes and vegetables. Some of the mussels had not opened, so they were bad and could not be eaten. Carrots were almost raw. Corn cob looked like either someone took a bite out of it or cut off a bad piece and tried to mask it with seasoning. Boo.

We kinda wanted dessert but didn't want to risk it. If I could

This is one of my favorite places in town!! The falafel pita is one of the best I ever had. Quality fresh ingredients every time, and the flavor profiles are always on point. The chicken plate is delicious as well. The staff is always very friendly and welcoming. I always feel at home when I eat here. The dessert cinnamon n honey pita is the best thing going. Great value, great food, great place!!

The vibe was the only thing that I would consider decent. 

The was just complete utter trash. I could've went to Applebee's an had a far better meal. 

I wouldn't recommend this restaurant to anyone.
The place certainly lived up to the hype. We went at 6:00 in a rainy Thursday morning so no lines and well worth it..

Left before ordering. The place stunk to high heaven like burnt manure. Then, the hostess sat us crowded next to another table, almost on top of them, we could not even walk between the tables, when there were clearly open tables that weren't so crowded and hard to get too. We go to Cracker Barrel's a lot and have really good experiences. This one might want to review their methods and aroma.

They ran out of almost everything by the time
I got there at 11 am on a Saturday; the crumbs that were left were delicious. Even with the line, hype and limited items I'll go back again. Soon! I'm excited to try everything on the menu.

Always great for a beer or game. Generous portions, good attitudes, and a fish bowl full of liquor. Never had a bad experience here. The food is good, the beer is cold. Plus they have a sweet ship model

I gave one star only because the food was great. We were seated immediately. It took such a long time for the waitress to take our drink order we had more than enough time we were ready to order our food also. We had asked for lemon for our water and that didn't come when our drinks. One of us ordered a salad for before the meal. The waitress brought the wrong salad and then came back to bring the correct salad. Thank goodness we didn't start to eat it. 
The food came out and it was really good. We finally got our lemon and we w were minus an order of cole slaw. We had to get up and ask another waitress (we couldn't find our waitress). Finally got the cole slaw half way through the meal. 
It took forever for our waitress to give us our check and messed it up so bad, it took three times, help from a manager and 30 minutes later for her to run it to get it correct. We were not the only table having issues with our bill. Overall, the food was great, service that day was terrible!

We stopped in for breakfast and were very pleasantly surprised here. It's small and there was a short wait for a table ( on a Sat. Morning that is to be expected anywhere around here)... the staff was quick, friendly and helpful. I had a skillet and my wife ordered eggs Benedict. Both were outstanding, and more than we could finish. We'll be back here.

Great service by Josie! Great food and drinks, we will definitely be returning.
Highly recommend the burger and the outdoor seating especially with the weather getting cooler.

Great burgers!
It host an authentic menu with some dishes you won't find anyone else.
I'm visiting Tampa and would recommend to anyone passing through!

Omg the Honey walnut shrimp is all I have to say! The shrimp fried rice definitely need more seasonings.   I've ordered it twice and the second time was still disappointing.   Egg drop soup seemed as if there's only  one egg added to a bowl of broth! The dishes are too pricey, to lack flavor! I always order to go, and I do not know if the waitress that's behind the bar is overwhelmed or not happy with her job, but she's always very short when paying and almost as if she throws the receipt down to the counter for a signature.   I overlooked it twice, but next time I will let her know!  She will lose Ming customers based on her actions alone! You are the face of this restaurant you should know better!

I'm surprised at the lack of reviews for this brand new Sam's.  It's in the Bashas shopping center in the same wing as Serial Grillers.  It's maybe the most well thought out and pleasant Sports bar restaurant I can remember going to.  The food is Famous Sam's good as well.  The have two patios, one out front and a smoking and dog friendly patio out back.  Chairs and tables are comfortable with TVs everywhere.  A large selection of draft beers too!  Close to my side of town as well.  Great spot.
Stopped here once, I love the location however the coffee was meh and the muffin was terrible. Also dark and dated inside.

This place has great owners and great customers! Every time I come in, I have the best conversations while waiting for my food. It's cooked to order, but the wait is worth it. Shanelle and Terell always recognize their regulars and have a kind word for them.

We went to Puccini's for pickup, wanting to avoid the big chains.  The vegetarian calzone was quite good, but the pizza crust was a bit too chewy and nearly inedible by day 2.  I'd go back for another calzone, but that's probably it.

My family and I went for dinner. They were very accommodating for private room seating, reordering a plate, and very understanding about a glass we broke. The food was delicious and the waitress was very polite.

Every time I come here I basically order the same thing, so this review is based on this dish I love, aka the Xian Liang Pi (cold noodles)! I always order this and it's a big portion for ~$7, and is soooo tasty. Perfect balance of vinegar and salty/sweet! Other than that I haven't tried many dishes or dined in but they're decent for the lower price range, so it's good for a quick and cheap meal.

Welp, here's my review 
      Cathy's offers a massive parking lot in the back with a walkway leading to the back patio. Walking into Cathy's Kitchen I couldn't help but feel warm and invited as the server immediately greeted us and offered us a seat. Drinks are self-serve so it's nice not having to wait for anybody. 
Now, I know you've been waiting for this. Yes, the food review, so let's begin! I ordered the Double Cheese burger with cajun fries off the Texas Order. Different states labeled different food, have a variety of food choices to choose from. The hamburger was delicious and massive in size. The wait for the food didn't take long either. I can say service was great and the food was better. I'm a student down the street and I'd recommend this place to all my peoples. 
Concluding my review, Cathy's Kitchen is a great place to eat with a great staff and overall welcoming feeling.
Came here for some good food & got even better service!! Our server was Jenna & she made our whole experience worth coming back!! The food was good but Jenna was great!! We'll be back!!

First time to Indy and my hotel was right near Blue Sushi. Not many options for a late arrival into town on a Sunday, so gave it a shot. 

Excellent and interesting options! This comes from someone who's been to Japan and lives in Los Angeles. The rolls I had were all very good! This included the Hot Popper, Spicy Gringo, traditional Salmon Skin and Philli rolls. My favorite was the Cherry Bomb (I should have ordered a second one). 

The prices for everything was very reasonable and size allows for two people to share each item. That makes for a lot of fun to order a bunch of things to try. 

I had two issues, all stemming from cleaning. First, for almost the entire time I was there, no one cleared the sushi bar area where at least three people sat. There were used dishes on a couple of tables as well. Not sure how a restaurant doesn't clear tables right away. 

Second, when they were shutting down they used the broom for the floor to brush off the seats as well. WHAT?!??!? That's just lazy. Get a rag, wipe the tables and seats. Keep the broom on the floor. That's a health / food serving violation. 

I'd give them another shot if they get there hygiene under control....

Food was a 4/4.5. Cleaning was a 2

I continuously come back to Peel for the Turkey Club. It never disappoints. The focaccia is amazing (and made in house!) and the sandwich is assembled so well. It can be a little salty sometimes but it's not too bad. I usually pair it with a salad and I live for the apple Gorgonzola salad. It's so simple yet delicious. I wish I could bottle the dressing and order the spiced walnuts to go. Curbside service is super convenient during Covid, but you're also able to dine inside or outside.
Went here for dinner and it is so good! My friend and I ordered the calamari, chicken chopped salad and smokehouse steak Cobb. Highly recommend!

The service was terrible and they were out of all the food on the menu. I literally had to pick my 5th choice of meal because the waitress kept coming back and telling us they were out. Appetizers took over an hour to come out, and even then we had to ask for and wait for silverware and plates. We would have been slightly happier had the waitress even tried to keep our drinks filled, but no. The manager had to get us drinks. Second time going to this restaurant, but never again will I waste my time.

Overall pretty decent. We got the chicken nuggets, fries and a drink. The nuggets were extra crispy which I'm not a fan of but I'm sure most people prefer. The fries were OK, nothing special in either direction. The speed of the drive they was quick and efficient. I really liked the garlic sauce!

You can get better Sushi from Publix.

Went to sushi happy hour, got a roll and a couple pieces of nigri.  

The salmon in the roll was substituted with some whitefish, probably tilapia. The fish was noticeably lighter color than the salmon in the nigiri.  Sushi rice tasted bland and unseasoned.  

Left quickly and got dinner elsewhere; waste of time and money.
Service is absolutely amazing! The services were on top of every need. The music playlist was incredible and the olive plate appetizer was delicious. Highly recommend

Fast Food? Definitely not. Not sure what the issue is with this place but they are definitely not fast. At first I thought they were so slow because people love this location so much that it is just packed all the time. I couldn't have been more wrong. I decided to pass on the drive thru because it was just too busy and I was hoping the inside would be faster. 
I walk in and see a bunch of people sitting down...I guess when I ordered I didn't realize these people weren't actually eating but were actually waiting for their food still. I am talking there was like 7 people waiting for food. I even heard one guy say he was waiting for 20 minutes already. I think I timed it to about 25 minutes myself from the time on the receipt to the time I walked out. Pretty ridiculous actually, but it is what it is. 

Other than that, I didn't have any issues with the food. The chicken tender meal I got was still really good and the flavor is what you would expect from the KFC brand. The service is what is driving this place down!

This is the worst service of any restaurant anywhere that I've been. We waited for a table and would occasionally check in to see when our table was available, since we noticed people who came afterwards were served before us. After waiting two hours, we checked in on our progress again and were told that the kitchen was closing and that they had accidentally skipped over us. If they had seated us and been polite, it would have been a disappointment but not a disaster. Instead the hostess yelled at a member of our party and was very rude. After an argument, we were seated and told we needed to choose what to eat immediately and leave 20 minutes after we ordered so that they could "count the money." WORST SERVICE EVER! They were unapologetic and rude; did not apologize, and given the long wait, we weren't able to go to the museums we'd planned to. They could have made up for it by seating us and providing a free drink or meal as an apology but instead they were catty mean girls. Te food was also not great-not worth making the trek out there and certainly not worth the wait. Everywhere else in New Orleans has the warmest staff and service so I would suggest you go elsewhere.
I came here for a large group and we were all impressed.This place is all about the fresh seafood - try the oysters and the crawfish.

While my parents had eaten here before, I hadn't. Usually my higher-end meal when I'm back is at my beloved Zahav (I'm going there in a few days), but this time we worked Vedge in. I'm very glad we did. It's a beautiful restaurant in what at one time was Philly's classic French restaurant Deux Cheminees.

I should note that none of us are vegan or even vegetarian, but that didn't matter. None of us missed meat or even cheese (which is saying a lot on my end) tonight. At the advice of our friendly and knowledgeable server, we ordered three from column A (Vedge Bar), three from column B (Dirt List) and three from Column C (The Grill). Among the highlights were the stuffed avocado (with romesco, pickled cauliflower, "fried" rice and black salt), the applewood smoked tofu (with black lentil vinaigrette, spring garlic slaw and toast), the romanesco "carbonara" (smoked trumpet mushrooms, almond and fregola), the smoked potato leek tart (charred spring onion puttanesca and green onion aioli), the wood roasted carrot (pumpernickel, crushed garbonzos, carrot mustard and carrot kraut) and the grilled maitake mushroom (smoked remoulade, celery root, stalk and leaf). Desserts were similarly delicious (we split the Persian Love Cake, which was nice and moist and "Black and Blue," which was dark chocolate namelaka, ube ice cream and blue matcha marshallow).

I've certainly eaten my share of vegan and vegetable-based cuisine before, but Vedge definitely stands head and shoulders above any o

40 minutes to deliver one sandwich to another store in the mall? easily could've gone to a grocery, bought my own meat, milked a cow and made my own cheese in the time it takes to drive 4 minutes. Granted, if you call twice asking about your order that seems to get thru to them

Had a hankering for really good seafood, and not fried, simply boiled bucket seafood like in Mass, Cape Cod etc.  Sadly I can't find anything remotely like The Boiling House near home (Yardley PA).  I remember my days living in Hoboken NJ and going to Just BeCaws in Jersey City.  Well, we found a suitable comparison to Just BeClaws and within only 40 minutes south in Cherry Hill NJ.

Look for the red fishing boat along Marlton Pike about, just 30 yards north of the Jaguar/Land Rover dealership on Marlton Pike in Cherry Hill.

They are located deep down the center of the shopping center stores back on the right down the steps.

With the pandemic, we called to check on inside seating and their protocols which met with our approval these days. Everyone is masked, many servers with gloves and cleaning between patrons.  Tables were spotless and readied with napkins, plates lobster bid and plastic disposable gloves.  No menus, QR code scan in a placard or you can use the Yelp menu.

Let me start by saying Dave, our server, was fantastic.  Handled all our questions, was courteous friendly and definitely attentive. 

Upon figuring out the menu and our interests we opt to pick our own dishes vs the larger multi-option dishes for the table.  I built my own seafood pot with Dungeness Crab Cluster, two large clusters weighing in at 1.25lbs of fabulous, succulent, perfectly cooked meat that was boiled with old bay and some garlic butter.  Was meal that will be remembered.  

My spouse had
I had the x3 tacos, one of each of the meat options.. she had the Goji bowl with Spicy Pork.. we agreed the tacos were good.. but the bowl was amazing and highly recommended!

After being in Philadelphia for the last 4 days we feel the Cheesesteaks here were better than any others we tried, especially the most popular places tourist go to that we found average at best.. We found Cleavers to have an exceptional menu selections of not just Cheesesteaks but other type choices of sandwiches.Very clean, excellent service, great selection of adult beverages, good times. We really enjoyed Cleavers. Go, you will not be disappointed.

After 8-hours of traveling, we needed to eat and didn't want to cook anything. 

We order Jason's deli for delivery, I got the New York Yankee, my wife got the loaded kids potato, and a kids PB&J for my son. First off, the delivery was amazing and ordering it via the Yelp app was super easy. The New York Yankees sandwich was insanely huge and loaded with corn beef, pastrami, Swiss all on toasted rye bread. This could have been easily shared. I enjoyed the whole thing and immediately wanted a nap. My wife loved her baked potato and couldn't imagine ordering a full-size spud, as the kid size was already substantial. 

We were quoted a delivery time of almost an hour, but were very surprised to see that our food was delivered in 30 minutes via contactless delivery. I was laying on the couch staring at my phone when the text came through, "your food has been delivered!"

We would for sure order from Jason's deli again hot food, huge portions, and fast delivery. I'm in!
Tried for the first time. Food is awesome and the triple hot sauce was nice and hot. Had the half and half with the brown rice, both the chicken and beef had great flavor.

We had two Italian hoagies and two cheese steaks delivered from Campo's in Philly to Dallas today and they tasted like we were right there eating them.

The goods arrived packed in a styrofoam container on ice packs, yet not frozen and in perfect condition. Rolls were fresh with the crunchy crust and the lettuce and tomatoes were fresh. Plus, it was loaded with an ample selection of Italian cold-cuts and cheese.

We did help-out the cheesesteaks by taking the meat out, loading it in a pan, adding the onions and whiz they had sent and warming them all up together. In the mean time we were warming the bun in the oven. We put the two together and it tasted just like we were there. 

We greatly appreciated this wonderful "taste of Philly", as we this year will miss the annual road trip there.

I was super excited for this location but after a several months, it's not my fave. They're always out of something. The dining area seems to always be a bit messy. The salad dressing is WAY OFF! THEY ARE NOT USING THE SAME RECIPE as other locations... It's REALLY DISGUSTING. If I'm in a pinch I will go as there aren't many fresher food options in the area, but if I have the time, I'll travel to the Abington location. A plus: The staff is usually friendly.

Not a lot to say from the outside in the strip mall. But when you walk in wow the place is amazing and this is the best Thai food I have had in 8 or 9 years...!!! Went here for my anniversary dinner as an alternate place and found a new favorite restaurant. Very moderately priced and the best Tai you will get!. It's a very cozy motif. Nice place to go for a date night or just together with some friends. Small restaurant but has great atmosphere in wonderful staff. I would recommend this to anyone over and over and over and over again. I plan on going back as much as possible to try every dish they have. It was that darn good!

And I am very picky so this place is great!

I love this quaint little Italian restaurant in old Kenner. The food is amazing! Portions are very reasonable and the atmosphere is that of an old school Italian restaurant. It's so obvious that the management and owners are passionate about their culture.

The meat are unfresh. The beef tastes of seafood (unfresh!!) Although we stopped order beef in time, I threw up after eating here.
The environment is extremely unfriendly to kids. The waiter put the high chair close to the pot without notice!!!! It's hot!!!
Will never never eat here again!!!

The service at this restaurant is terrible. Their customer service is abysmal.  My fiancée placed an order over the phone they gave us 15 mins till the food would be complete. When I arrived I was told no such order exist. I told she must be mistaken. She Proceeded to ignore me and go back to working instead of trying to fix the situation with me.Unbeknownst to her I've ordered from this place  numerous times.But due to being so rude They have lost my patronage and the patronage of any of my Colleagues.  Horrible customer service

Don't order to go from them unless you go through everything and make sure they aren't ripping you off. I ordered the classic Caesar salad with chicken. This is a $15 salad and is supposed to come with black olives, red onions, and Roma tomato. It is in a side salad box no bigger than my hand. No olives, tomato, or onion. Such a joke for $15. Every time I order here it is always wrong. Not sure why it's so difficult to read a receipt and give your customers what they are already overpaying for.

This is one of my favorite places to eat in all of South Jersey and don't get here enough. Their wings are in my top 5 in all of South Jersey - so crispy and awesome wing sauce. Spicy Pork Dolsot is probably my favorite dish, and really can't go wrong with any of them. You can alter any dish so they're not too spicy, but if you enjoy a lot of heat you'll really love it here. L.A. Kalbi is also terrific and a Korean classic. The spicy pork and beef sandwiches are also a pleasant surprise. So much I've tried and never had a bad experience!

I've always loved Garrett's for their convenience and value for a quick breakfast, and especially for the service, but damn if they don't have Fox News playing on the TV whenever I go in there. It's plain out offensive, and while many will object, it's time to take a stand against those so responsible for the divisiveness of our country so that I will be boycotting Garrrett's until they choose to stop spreading propaganda rubbish to their clientele.

No doubt it is hard to do so many different types of food well. The menu is very broad and, as a result, underwhelming. I ordered the Cobb salad and was extremely disappointed. A huge bowl of mostly lettuce. Not a great balance of ingredients. 

Others who dined with me were not pleased either. We were excited to have a new place in the area and have not returned as the food was average.

On any given morning you're going to wait 20 minutes in line before you get to even place your order. 
I'm not sure why that's a thing when it's not like they're picky about who they're hiring...I'm sure there are people who need a job, and that would solve the unacceptable wait times. 
I'm not sure what to say about the fact that when you order a Nova bagel and are charged for extra lox you're not getting what you are paying for which is an extra ounce. You're also getting four capers divided up between the two halves. And you're getting red onion cut with the thickness of a monster truck tire. 
I called corporate and was contacted by someone who claimed they were going to be sending me a gift card, never received it. When I followed up I was ignored. 
Also just so you know how asinine this establishment is... I was charged $18 for ONE SINGLE Nova bagel with an extra ounce of lox.

Retro comes to mind with this place. With business cards shellacked to the tables. I am not sure how long this place has been around but seems like it would be quite the hand out back in the day. 
The food was good and the value was even better. The fried crab claws was a heaping serving and the oyster stew reminded me of lobster stew from New England, just oysters instead of lobster. 
The server was great as was the rest of the staff with that welcome when you walk through the door. 
My only correction for what is advertised is outdoor seating. This is more of a smoking section and it is really close to a dumpster so I can't imagine anyone actually eats outdoors here. So if you are looking to eat outside. This is not the place.
Atmosphere is nice. All workers were very nice. However mixed drinks are horrible! If you're not drinking beer or the shot advertised, you're in trouble.

Stopped in for breakfast after driving by the Pancake Pantry that had a line outside around the block. There was a short wait for a table but we were able to plop down at the bar for full service. Food was great, staff was friendly .

This shrimp po boy was so good. The bread is lightly toasted but still super soft. There is so much shrimp it's literally falling out of the sandwich.  After the sandwich you've still got a whole other serving of shrimp. They use only a little mayo, which is the key to the best po boys.

Never a disappointment ever, only place in Reno I'll get carne asada tacos. Chips and salsa are always great, everything I've had is always amazing. Not to fancy but still makes you feel like sitting back and enjoying the food and atmosphere.

Back to Cuba has been on my list of places to try for quite a while.  I finally got the chance to go last weekend.  As others have written, the restaurant is very small and is in a stripmall and gas station.  Don't let that dissuade you from trying this place.

We had a group of six people.  I would not advise this, since most of the tables are two-tops and you have to be very lucky to arrive at a time when you can push three tables together.  No reservations.  No hostess.  It is counter service for ordering.

The menu is quite simple - sandwiches and entrees.  They had two specials the night we went and I tried the Ropa Vieja special.  They do not serve alcohol, but you probably can bring your own.  We waited 10-15 minutes for our food to be brought out.  Not long to wait except I was starving!

The food was very flavorful.  A bit on the salty side.  My entree came with fried plantains that were absolutely the best.  Slightly sweet and perfectly cooked.  There was a huge scoop of rice and a pretty good size bowl of black beans.  The Ropa Vieja was served in a little dish on the side to keep it from running all over the plate.

We ordered empanadas to share.  They were huge!  Lots of filling in the middle but a lot of empty crust around the edges.  I wish it had been spread out a little more but what was filled was delicious.

We were there at 6:30 and around 7pm, the owner put a sign on the door.  It turns out, they were closing the restaurant early because they ran out of f
We eat here ALL THE TIME!!!  They are one of the best breakfast/lunch places around!!  Always friendly service and absolute quality food!!!

Our group tried to eat here on a Friday night around 6pm and the wait time was around 1.5 hours. We ended up nearby but came back the following day at the same time, 6pm, and only waited 20mins. You order on your phones. I'm not sure if this is implemented in response to Covid or if they always did this but it was nice for our group of 9 to order and pay individually without the hassle of asking to split checks and the ease in leaving whenever we are finished. The food also came out rapidly by so many different servers that you really get that exposure to all of the friendly staff. 

One of the servers recommended the cauliflower and pork belly tacos. Naturally, I ordered both. Boy am I glad I did! The cauliflower taco was cooked to a tender but not mushy state and topped with a spicy sauce that left you wanting more. I could easily go vegan if I could live off of this taco everyday of my life. The pork belly taco was also a tender, well-marinated meat with a crispy coating. The glaze is slightly sweet which complements the satisfying saltier umami of the meat. 

I now see why the wait is as long as it is because the food is worth the hype. 

The staff is also so friendly, hip, and young. We particularly bonded with the kind hostess Julia who was always checking in to see if we needed anything else.
Every entree we have tried has been great! Good service and reasonably priced. The restaurant decor is a bit tired and needs updating. Staff is pleasant and attentive. Food arrives quickly!

This is a great place to get some 5 star crepes! The crepes were delicious and so many varieties! The only possible negative thing that I would say about this café is that their venue is VERY small. They however are not in control of this. This is why I have it 5 stars.

Twice we went thru drive thru asking for fries as twice we got stale cold fries so the first time I brought them right back literally seconds after we got them
Someone simply gave us two more from the same stale batch - I went thru again saying the 2nd ones
Were just as bad then they finally cooked more
ALSO my buttermilk crispy sandwich had a couple pieces of shredded lettuce and the tomato that comes on it - WELL it was the size of a penny !
So small it was astonishing- who thought the teeny tiny bit qualified as a tomato slice 
The absolute worst McDonalds
And I live right close but will
Drive over farther to the one off 75 and 54
Stay away from this one they got bad reviews and don't seem to be trying to fix anything
We catered our renewal of our vows with the roast beef sandwiches.  Thank you to Chris and his son who prep everything perfectly. I wish I took photos.

I have been very curious about this new place the popped up in the round cornor spot at 96th and Allisonville. I haven't been in this space since it was my local Starbucks. 
I was very happy with my experience here. The staff was very friendly and helpful.  I ordered the Pabellon Arepa and my friend ordered the Pabellon Bowl. The food was served quickly.  It was hot and very tasty.  The ingredients were high quality and our meal was very filling.  We also got some mango juice which was a nice treat. Looking forward to coming back again.

I feel obligated to share my experience with those who may be considering going to this restaurant. I was initially intrigued and drawn in as they consider themselves " healthy fast food" and since I prefer healthy options and was limited on time I thought I'd check them out. 
I ordered a hot bowl with the option of veggies over grains with curry. When my bowl came out, the cilantro looked like it was pulled directly from the garden, stems still intact. After de-stemming, I dug down deep in the bowl to get a bite of veggies, which after biting into were clearly still frozen, yuck! I promptly took my bowl up front to let the person behind the counter know and she offered to make me a new bowl. The next bowl, came out piping hot, but what I realized is that the cauliflower, broccoli, and carrots were clearly frozen, like the ones you buy at Giant. The curry had no flavor and there was a significant amount of water in the bottom of the bowl. 
When I see healthy food advertised I thought fresh, and honestly even the cilantro although pulled from the garden was dark green and mushy in spots. Needless to say I won't be back for more. 

I wasn't planning on giving any stars but yelp won't let me.  So the one is for the staff who were nice!

This place is a must if you love German food. The food is fantastic,  but it's on the pricey side for the atmosphere. There are only a few tables inside and picnic tables outside. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly. I would love a more comfortable intimate setting, but you can't beat the food.
They have great German beer on tap and interesting specials.

We've come here 4 times and each time we feel disappointed. It's not bad, but it's not good. The outside is cool, but just missing something. The food is just ok. Since it's overpriced it makes it not worth it at all. We've had the Cuban, fish and chips, philly, wings, burgers, and pizza. Nothing was any better than any other bar. Drinks are always watered down.  We truly have no idea why it's always packed. Sucks since we really wanted to like this place.

Didn't quite know what to expect from my first visit to the Missing Brick but my expectations will be high on my next visit. 

The Missing Brick moved into the spot that used to be the Black Diamond BBQ restaurant. 

There's decent parking and a very good vibe you feel when entering the building. The art work on the walls has a graffiti feel and Que, the guy at the counter,  was very helpful in helping me decide what to order. 

I ordered a  1/2 & 1/2: 1/2 OG and the other 1/2 was the Trap which is a seafood pizza which is a collaboration with Chef Oya's the trap restaurant. 

The crust was hand tossed thickness that was not too thick and not too thin. 

The OG was loaded with bacon, sausage, pepperoni, ham and beef. A true meat lovers dream. The pizza sauce was authentic and flavorful. 

The Trap Pizza was a pleasant surprise. Crab and shrimp In a garlic "buttah" sauce was fabulous. 

The Missing Brick deserves to be in the best pizza places in Indy conversation.
Brisket is ON TIME. sweet and honey badger sauces are legit! Baked beans were good and the krazy korn was just ok. For sure a good bbq spot.

Ya'll I'm old school southern so I have to start this review with "Have Mercy!" We were passing through on our way to Gatlinburg for soccer and found this place on Yelp. I am not a fan of chains and would rather support locally owned places.  This place was 100% worth the short distance from the interstate. They have a great beer selection. (I like the weird craft beers but they also have the standard fare. Ya'll don't judge me.) My husband and I could decide what to get because everything looked so good. So we decided to get 2 entree's and split them. I had the mother clucker + Brussel sprouts. He had the French dip + fries and wasabi slaw.  Seriously everything was awesome. The sprouts and slaw were the best I've ever had. Both sandwiches were incredible.  10/10 recommend Catch 22. 

The service was perfect. I forgot to get the fella's name that waited on us but he was fantastic. 

Side note: we started with the snack board (charcuterie) and it was very nice...more than 2 hungry travelers could eat so we boxed it up for the 3.5 hour drive to East Tennessee.
First time here today! Service was excellent and the pho came out fast and super fresh with giant shrimp and fresh veggies.  Will be back ASAP for more yummy treats!

Waited one hour for a curbside order.  Was told by an employee 30 minutes in that my order was ready and they would bring it right out.  That never happened.  As I was leaving I noticed that no food handlers were wearing gloves or masks.  Oh also, what the hell is up with allowing people into the restaurant to place and pick up orders.  

I normally love me some Five Guys, but this was an awful and disheartening experience.
